visualCharacteristics.structure: 2x2 grid of linked cards: head row (category tag left, bracketed stat + caption right), H3, paragraph, footer row (time-to-value left, link right)
visualCharacteristics.summary: 2x2 grid of linked accelerator items, each with category tag, large bracketed stat + caption, H3, paragraph, footer row with time-to-value and 'See the playbook' label

contentPattern.structure: one row per accelerator, one cell: category tag paragraph, stat paragraph (e.g. [81%], bold or bracketed), stat caption paragraph, H3, description paragraph, time-to-value paragraph, and a final paragraph with a single link (makes the whole card clickable)
